subject: geography
title: Urbanization and cities
objective: Explain why cities grow and how they are sited.

lesson.opening: More than half the world’s people now live in cities, and the share keeps rising. Cities grow through migration and natural increase.

sections.heading: Urbanization
sections.body: Urbanization is the rising share of people living in towns and cities. It usually follows economic change as work shifts from farming to industry and services.

sections.heading: Why cities sit where they do
sections.body: A city’s site is its immediate setting, such as a river bend or harbour. Its situation is its position relative to the wider region, such as a crossroads of trade.

sections.heading: Megacities
sections.body: A megacity has more than ten million people. Many are now in Asia and the global South.

choices: A rising share of people living in cities
Its position in the wider region
